page.summary: Get another useful use from a valuable item when restoring or conserving its charges repays the time away from the team objective.

verdict.recommendation: Treat the item as a finite investment: choose a charge plan that matches the actual item and leave it when recharge costs more than the next use returns.
verdict.soloQ: Recharge only after the item is depleted and there is a safe pause; do not leave a live rescue for a locker visit.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Assign the item to the player who can use the next charge window and have teammates cover the objective during a deliberate recharge pause.
verdict.mainWeakness: Locker downtime, item loss and the separate conditions of each recharge tool can break the expected return.

options.whyItsHere: Restores a depleted item's charges through a locker visit when the next use is worth leaving the current task.
Extends charges on items retrieved from chests; it is a conservation route for found items, not a refill for every equipped item.
Offers a conditional depleted-Toolbox refill for a player who can land the required Great repair checks and absorb the following repair penalty.

weaknesses: The plan depends on preserving a valuable item and on a safe window to restore or spend its charges.
commonMistakes: Entering a locker before the item is depleted and expecting Built to Last to refill it.
Treating Streetwise as a recharge for an item brought from the lobby.
Planning Scavenger around ordinary or special Skill Checks instead of its required Great basic repair checks.

opening: Name the item and its next useful task before committing a slot to charge economy.

rows.situation: The item is depleted, another use would matter, and a locker is safe without missing a rescue or generator window.
rows.action: Take the Built to Last locker recharge, then return to the item task; skip it when travel and hiding would cost more than the recovered use.
rows.why: The refill pays only when the restored charges are used in time.

rows.situation: You retrieve a charge-bearing item from a chest.
rows.action: Use the Streetwise-extended charges on the next relevant task; do not expect the effect on an item brought into the Trial.
rows.why: Its charge benefit is tied to found items.

rows.situation: A Toolbox is depleted and you can keep repairing long enough for Scavenger's Great-check condition.
rows.action: Continue the repair route only if the later Toolbox refill can repay the check effort and temporary repair slowdown; otherwise switch to ordinary repair or another item plan.
rows.why: The payoff is conditional and carries a repair cost.

rows.situation: The item is lost, the next use is no longer relevant, or pressure removes the safe recharge window.
rows.action: Stop routing to lockers or chasing charges and return to the team's immediate objective.
rows.why: A charge engine without a useful next item action is sunk cost.

abortWhen: Do not recharge during an urgent rescue or while the item cannot be used soon.
Abandon the item loop after loss or when its recharge condition cannot be met safely.
